why: I compared each verifier check's PASS/FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1–3 and 5 mostly stay within their words. Check 4 goes further. Its line only says "lint(text) in src/index.js is unchanged", but its FAIL condition is "any diff in packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js", backed by `git diff --exit-code` over the whole file. That is a file-scope rule the words don't force: a new export or an edited comment elsewhere in the file would fail the check even with lint(text) untouched. Check 6 also adds "the PR is open", which "one PR" doesn't require. Both should have gone under Advisory. So the output breaks the criterion.
